name: duopore-public-weekly-routine-review
description: See how your planned routine compares with the sessions you recorded this week.

interface.longDescription: See how your planned routine compares with the sessions you recorded this week. Share planned and actual minutes and whether each entered session was done. Get weekly totals and completion counts. For adults reviewing their own routine. Days you did not record stay unknown; they are not marked as failures. The app does not diagnose habits, health or motivation.
defaultPrompt: Compare my planned and actual routine sessions this week.
Summarize completion from these recorded sessions without guessing missing days.

positive.prompt: Use Weekly Routine Review with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"weekStart":"2026-09-28","entries":[{"date":"2026-09-28","routine":"Read","plannedMinutes":30,"actualMinutes":20,"completed":true},{"date":"2026-09-29","routine":"Read","plannedMinutes":30,"actualMinutes":0,"completed":false},{"date":"2026-09-30","routine":"Practice","plannedMinutes":20,"actualMinutes":25,"completed":true}]}

review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.

publication.release_notes: Clear benefit-first descriptions and original bold geometric branding with light/dark icon variants. App behavior, privacy, connections and review evidence unchanged.
